title: Creatio Sponsors Boston AI Week 2026, Supporting AI Innovation in Its Hometown
summary: Boston-headquartered company joins the region’s AI community to spotlight how people and AI agents can transform business together
body_markdown:
Creatio, an AI CRM and workflow platform where people and AI agents work together — with no limits on users, agents, or scale —today announced its participation as a premier sponsor of Boston AI Week 2026. With its global headquarters in Boston, Creatio’s sponsorship reflects its commitment to the local AI community and to helping organizations turn AI innovation into everyday business value.


Boston AI Week’s core festival week takes place September 24–October 2, within a broader program running September 16–October 28 across Massachusetts. Building on a 2025 edition that drew more than 15,000 participants, the festival connects founders, business leaders, researchers, investors, and the wider network to explore, build, and advance AI.


As a premier sponsor, Creatio is supporting the connections between research, technology, and enterprise adoption that strengthen Boston’s AI ecosystem. Through panel participation at the Opening Party and the Boston AI Summit’s “Building AI” discussion, Creatio will share its vision for an enterprise where people and AI agents work together to run customer and operational worklows.


“Boston is home to an extraordinary community of people shaping the future of AI, and we’re proud to support that community,” said Jason Olkowski, Chief Strategy & Transformation Officer at Creatio. “For businesses, the opportunity is to make AI part of everyday work—helping teams serve customers, simplify processes, and turn ideas into results. Boston AI Week brings together the experience and ideas needed to move that work forward.”


Creatio’s impact in Boston extends to the city itself.[The City of Boston](https://www.creatio.com/page/customer-success/city-of-boston) replaced legacy 311 infrastructure with Creatio’s AI CRM platform, modernizing non-emergency services for more than 675,000 residents. The transformation helps city teams coordinate service delivery across departments and introduce improvements faster—bringing AI-native innovation to Creatio’s hometown.


To learn more about the festival and explore the full agenda, visit[aiweek.boston](https://aiweek.boston/) .


**About Creatio**


Creatio is an AI CRM and workflow platform where people and AI agents work together — with no limits on users, agents, or scale. We help midsize and large organizations run customer workflows in the AI era. Headquartered in Boston, MA, with a global team and a large ecosystem of partners, Creatio serves thousands of customers in over 100 countries and automates tens of millions of workflows daily. Genuine care for our clients and partners is at the heart of our DNA.
